name: CabeCare iOS Project
description: Plant care iOS application with VIPER Clean Architecture
rules: ALWAYS follow VIPER Clean Architecture pattern for all modules
NEVER put multiple classes or structs in the same file - one class per file is MANDATORY
Split files into extensions when exceeding 200 lines using pattern: ClassName+Purpose.swift
All UI components must be in Common/Views/ directory with clear naming
Follow naming convention: View, Presenter, Interactor, Router, Entity, Contract
Use MARK comments for code organization in every file
Avoid property name conflicts when subclassing UIKit classes
Use dependency injection via Router.createModule() pattern
Keep business logic in Interactor, presentation logic in Presenter
Navigation must be handled by Router, not View
Always use weak references for delegates and protocols
Apply Clean Code principles: readable, maintainable, testable

conventions.accessControl: private by default, internal for module, public for framework
